description: This file provides an API client for a PDF logo replacement workflow, including functions to start jobs, check status, get previews, confirm results, and download PDFs.

methods.name: startLogoReplaceJob
methods.description: Starts a PDF logo replacement job by uploading files and parameters, returning a job ID.

methods.name: getJobStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status, progress, and findings of a specific job.

methods.name: getPreviewUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL for a page preview (detected or replaced) for a specific job.

methods.name: confirmJob
methods.description: Confirms the results of a job, possibly finalizing the changes.

methods.name: downloadPdf
methods.description: Downloads the corrected PDF as a Blob for a given job.
